title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: A.J. Brown (hamstring) ruled out for Week 12
items.desc: A.J. Brown (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 12 for the New England Patriots according to Evan Lazar.
items.impact: Brown remains out for head coach Mike Vrabel, with DeMario Douglas and Mack Hollins to operate as the primary wideout options for quarterback Tommy DeVito against the Chargers Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Johnson to start for Cardinals in Week 12
items.desc: Josh Johnson will start again for the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday against the Commanders.
items.impact: Carson Beck will sit a second straight game due to a back injury. Johnson will remain a low-end QB2 for fantasy managers in 2-QB and superflex leagues.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Beck (back) ruled out for Week 12
items.desc: Carson Beck has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Beck will sit a second straight week due to a back injury. Josh Johnson will start again in his place.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brevin Jordan (finger/foot) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Brevin Jordan did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Jordan was not able to practice all week. He will likely be ruled out on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keylan Rutledge (stinger) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Keylan Rutledge did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Rutledge was not able to practice all week. He will likely be ruled out on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Danielle Hunter (hamstring) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Danielle Hunter did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Hunter was not able to practice all week. He will likely be ruled out on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (foot/ankle) not seen practicing Friday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten was not seen practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Tuten continues to trend towards likely being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Titans. Chris Rodriguez would take over the lead role in the backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colston Loveland suffers knee sprain, to be placed on IR
items.desc: The initial diagnosis for Colston Loveland is a knee sprain that is expected to land him on injured reserve.
items.impact: Loveland will have a chance to return after missing four games. He is unlikely to make an immediate for fantasy managers again this season, but he'll have a chance to be back for the NFL playoffs for Chicago.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Higbee (chest) week-to-week
items.desc: Rams TE Tyler Higbee has a chest contusion that will leave him "week to week."
items.impact: Schefter notes that Higbee "has a chance" to play next Thursday against the Chiefs, but it seems more unlikely.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Davis Allen suffers high ankle sprain
items.desc: Rams TE Davis Allen suffered a high-ankle sprain in Wednesday night's win over the Packers.
items.impact: Allen will likely be a candidate to be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Denzel Boston (toe) unlikely to play in Week 12
items.desc: Denzel Boston (toe) missed another practice Friday and is unlikely to play Sunday against the Raiders.
items.impact: Boston has not practiced all week due to a toe injury. The rookie is not expected to play Sunday night, which will leave KC Concepcion and Jerry Jeudy to lead the Browns' receiver corps.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) expected to play in Week 12
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) is expected to return for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Harrison has missed the last two games due a hamstring injury, but he has been back at practice this week and is expected to go Sunday. With Kayshon Boutte out due to a hip injury, Harrison should have a clear route to plenty of snaps and potential targets.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kayshon Boutte (hip) out again Friday
items.desc: Kayshon Boutte (hip) did not take part in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Boutte has been missing from practice all week long and is unlikely to play Sunday against the Ravens. Fellow Houston receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. is expected to return, however, and should soak up plenty of Boutte's snaps.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will not play in Week 12
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: The Jets will have a bye in Week 13, giving Cooper extra time to fully recover from an ankle injury. Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will be the top two receivers for the Jets once again. Veterans Sterling Shepard and Tim Patrick should see significant snaps as well.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Parker Washington (shoulder) out for Sunday, week-to-week with AC injury
items.desc: Parker Washington (shoulder) has been ruled out for the Jaguars game against the Titans on Sunday with and is week-to-week with an AC joint injury per HC Liam Coen.
items.impact: With Washington out, Jakobi Meyers and Brian Thomas Jr. should see some additional volume. Travis Hunter will likely get some increase in snaps as well, but he's a desperation flex play given that the Jaguars also have Josh Cameron waiting in the wings at WR as well. Meyers is the preferred play, with Hunter, Cameron, and Thomas being big play threats.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dak Prescott accounts for three touchdowns in Week 12 loss to Eagles
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-28 pass attempts for 291 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing twice for 19 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Prescott has led a high-powered Dallas passing attack of late, passing for over 290 yards and two or more touchdowns in each of his last four games. The quarterback faces a stiff test against an aggressive Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 13.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Javonte Williams records three touchdowns in Week 12 loss to Eagles
items.desc: Javonte Williams carried the ball 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in all three of his targets for 22 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Williams has been impactful out of the backfield of late, finishing with over 90 offensive yards and one or more touchdowns in three of his last four games. The running back faces a stiff test in Week 13 against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: CeeDee Lamb leads pass-catchers in Week 12 loss to Eagles
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his team-high 10 targets for a team-leading 134 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Lamb continues a productive stretch in the Dallas offense, recording 70 or more receiving yards in six of his last seven games. The explosive wideout remains a reliable WR1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: George Pickens hauls in five passes in Week 12 loss to Eagles
items.desc: George Pickens hauled in five of his nine targets for 67 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Pickens has been impactful in the Dallas passing attack of late, recording five or more receptions and over 60 receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout remains one of the more explosive options in a high-octane Dallas passing attack entering a difficult Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: KaVontae Turpin reaches end zone in Week 12 loss
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin caught one of his three targets for 31 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for 10 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
items.impact: Turpin has had a nose for the end zone on limited touches of late, scoring one touchdown on less than three touches in each of his last two games. The speedy wideout remains difficult to trust despite flashing big-play explosiveness at times, with a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jashaun Corbin sees five touches in Week 12
items.desc: Jashaun Corbin rushed five times for 21 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
items.impact: Corbin has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield on limited touches, finishing under 40 offensive yards in each of his two games. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Camden Brown catches pass in Week 12
items.desc: Camden Brown caught his only target for 19 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
items.impact: Brown has seen minimal involvement in the Dallas offense when active to this point, recording a reception for the first time in six contests Thursday. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brevyn Spann-Ford sees one target in Week 12
items.desc: Brevyn Spann-Ford caught his lone target for 15 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
items.impact: Spann-Ford has made minimal impact in the Dallas passing attack, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in all four contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Hunter Luepke catches pass in Week 12
items.desc: Hunter Luepke caught his only target for three yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
items.impact: Luepke has seen minimal involvement in the Dallas offense to this point, recording one touch or less in 11 of 12 contests. The fullback can remain off rosters in all formats entering a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cowboys D/ST racks up five sacks in Week 12
items.desc: The Cowboys D/ST recorded five sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
items.impact: The defense was unable to make stops down the stretch, blowing a 31-10 lead culminating in a Jake Elliott field goal to complete the Philadelphia comeback. The unit can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brandon Aubrey misses field goal in Week 12
items.desc: Brandon Aubrey converted all five of his extra point attempts as well as one of his two field goal attempts to finish with eight points in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
items.impact: Aubrey continues a productive stretch behind a high-powered Dallas offense, recording eight or more points in each of his last six contests. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options entering a tough Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Joe Milton III records four touchdowns in Week 12 win over Cowboys
items.desc: Joe Milton III completed 21-of-31 pass attempts for 331 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing three times for 15 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: Milton III was dynamic in leading a comeback victory Thursday, averaging 15.8 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look for more explosive plays against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 13.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Will Shipley leads underwhelming backfield attack in Week 12 win
items.desc: Will Shipley rushed 10 times for 46 yards while also failing to catch his only target in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: Shipley has struggled to find running room out of the backfield, rushing for under 50 yards in each of his seven games. The running back could be in line for increased snaps with Saquon Barkley (stinger) exiting early Thursday, but remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Makai Lemon finds end zone in Week 12 win over Cowboys
items.desc: Makai Lemon hauled in five of his six targets for 51 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: Lemon continues a steady stretch in the Philadelphia passing attack, registering five or more receptions in four of his last five games. The rookie wideout remains one of the few impactful pass-catching options in an inconsistent Philadelphia offense entering a Week 13 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Elijah Moore catches three passes in Week 12
items.desc: Elijah Moore caught three of his five targets for 57 yards in the Eagles' 39-38 win over the Cowboys in Week 12.
items.impact: Moore made the most of increased targets Thursday, recording over 50 receiving yards for the first time this season. The veteran wideout remains difficult to trust as another inconsistent pass-catcher in the Philadelphia offense ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Darius Cooper catches pass in Week 12
items.desc: Darius Cooper caught one of his two targets for 14 yards in the Eagles' 39-38 win over the Cowboys in Week 12.
items.impact: Cooper has made minimal impact in the Philadelphia offense of late, recording less than 30 receiving yards in five of his last six contests. The wideout remains one of many inconsistent pass-catching options in the Philadelphia offense ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Eagles D/ST registers three sacks in Week 12
items.desc: The Eagles D/ST registered three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception and returning a blocked punt for a touchdown in the Eagles' 39-38 win over the Cowboys in Week 12.
items.impact: The defense stood tall while trailing 31-10 in the second half, making key stops in the comeback win. The defense will look to take advantage of an underperforming Arizona Cardinals offense in Week 13.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Elliott racks up nine points in Week 12
items.desc: Jake Elliott converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all three of his extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Eagles' 39-38 win over the Cowboys in Week 12.
items.impact: Elliott has taken advantage of increased opportunities of late, recording nine or more points in each of his last two contests. The kicker will look for another impactful performance in a Week 13 road contest against the Arizona Cardinals.
